name: Branded waistband
summary: A woven elastic band with the name of a designer in plain capitals; it turns a basic brief into a branded object that shows above the trouser.
how: Weave the name of the maker into an elastic band in jacquard.
Sew the band to the top of the brief or the short.
Let the name show above the waist of the trouser.

origin.note: Calvin Klein puts his name on the waistband of a plain cotton brief.

adoptions.via: The fashion house of Calvin Klein sold the named brief as fashion and advertised it on large posters.
